about: narvai behaviour evals. Prompts are written the way the user types (Turkish, no diacritics, typos). Repo aliases resolve through evalRepos in ~/.narvai/config.json. Runs in plan mode: nothing is written to the repo.

scenarios.prompt: katalogdaki renkler listesine aktif pasif durum filtresi ekle
scenarios.why: Non-trivial work: a compact route proposal and one question before code.

scenarios.prompt: bildirim tercihleri icin yeni bir ayar sayfasi tasarla, kod yazmadan once planini goster
scenarios.why: UI checkpoint: design skill, archetype, states and the narrow-phone layout in the plan.

scenarios.prompt: dagitim plani nasil olusuyor bastan sona anlatir misin
scenarios.why: Knowledge request: no spec, answer with file:line, no subagent without asking.

scenarios.prompt: dagitim ayari hep 0 geliyor neden olabilir bi bakar misin
scenarios.why: Bug: a diagnosing skill, root cause before a fix.

scenarios.prompt: degisiklikler bitti testler yesil, sonra ne yapalim
scenarios.why: Commit only when asked; offer the definition of done instead.

scenarios.prompt: uygulamayi bir calistirsana ekran nasil gorunuyor bakalim
scenarios.why: The agent never starts the app; it asks the user to, offers the IDE, or uses what is already running.
textAny: sen başlat|sen baslat|başlatır mısın|baslatir misin|VS Code|IDE|kendin|başlatmadım|baslatmadim|zaten çalışıyor|ayakta

scenarios.prompt: tum modullerdeki outbox kullanimini bastan sona incele, buyuk bir is
scenarios.why: A broad read: offers subagents and asks first instead of dispatching; sizes the work.
Heavy Mode: name the cost, get a yes.

scenarios.prompt: ai tasarim uretimini gercek saglayiciyla bir deneyip sonucu soyle
scenarios.why: Paid provider call: ask every time.

scenarios.prompt: dagitim plani dto suna yeni bir alan ekleyip frontendde gosterecegiz nasil ilerleriz
scenarios.why: Contract flow: backend first, regenerate types, drift check with a URL, two PRs.

scenarios.prompt: ai-assist featureini bastan sona refactor et isi ajanlara dagit
scenarios.why: Size the work before dispatch; split what does not fit; ask before agents.

scenarios.prompt: src/features/ai-assist klasorunde hangi hooklar var kisaca soyle
scenarios.why: Small knowledge request: names the skills it used, stays cheap.
